_note: Owner-declared strategy pins (§7,522·B·2, widened 09-09-2026 13:35 SGT: "set them ON for ALL … all accounts are consider as cluster"; PR-B 11-09-2026, owner principle 9: one list for every account, no ids). Applied at boot by seedStrategyPinsFromConfig: "_all" pins every strategy listed ON for Auto Trade & Open on EVERY enabled account's overlay, an account enabled later included on its first boot (a hand pin — the evidence gate admits it, the adaptive breaker and the edge watchdog hold it against a POOLED verdict but NOT against that account's OWN streak/no-edge record, which still writes the cell false); an existing true cell is left alone; a per-id key would still win for that id; POST /actions/stage-matrix changes a cell live until the next boot re-applies this file. CHANGED 16-09-2026 (owner decision, this PR): tsmom_long IS now pinned here. It used to be excluded — "the momentum book's own" — and the measured cost was that the only strategy family with edge (PF 1.5–2.9 at 10–60 days) ran on 1 of 7 enabled accounts: it ships defaultOn:false (services/strategies.js), nothing in the codebase armed it, and momentum-book.js gates its whole per-account pass on armedTradeKeys(...).has('tsmom_long'). Meanwhile config/momentum-account.json has said "accountId": "_all" since PR-B — the TARGETING switch was moved to every account and the ARMING switch was not. This line closes that gap declaratively, so an account enabled later is armed on its first boot like every other strategy here. Side effect the owner has NOT separately ruled on, reported not decided: an explicit true cell IS a hand pin (isHandPinned, stage-matrix.js:241), so tsmom_long now takes the pin exemption in adaptive-breaker.js and edge-watchdog.js — held against a POOLED verdict, still disarmed where that ACCOUNT's own loss streak (accountsWithOwnStreak) or own no-edge window (accountsWithOwnNoEdge) reads bad. The immunity is not separable: armedTradeKeys reads only the overlay cell, so any per-account arm is a pin. It changes nothing at the evidence gate (evidence-gate.js already admits tsmom_long everywhere via momentum_account) and nothing at the risk gate's per-account verdict, which momentum-book.js does not call — the overlay cell is the only automatic brake on the book's entries.
